answer_1.quote: We first introduce a robust, principled, and carefully designed pipeline for imageto-text conversion that captures the richness of visual information... enabling language models to process visual content purely through text.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we opt for mean Average Precision (mAP) and F1-score... We also report Recall@1 and Recall@10 on standard benchmarks and measure a 69% match score with ground‑truth object classes in MS‑COCO.
